P048.authors: M Chen, W Zhai, S Zhu, L Xu, Y Sun
P048.label: Chen等（2022）

complete_examples.text: The failure of rail fastener is simulated by setting the stiffness and damping of rail fasteners to be zeroes in the compiled vehicle-track coupled model.

In the present work, only the failure of rail fasteners is taken into consideration, which will directly lead to the abrupt change of the vertical/lateral stiffness and damping of the track supports, and be viewed as a dangerous factor to the traffic danger, uncomfortableness , and cracks propagation, etc.
Firstly, three damage categories are defined and five damage degrees are equivalently represented by modifying the stiffness and damping coefficients of target fasteners.

As an essential component of the railway tracks, the rail fastener system, through which desirable stiffness is provided to support the rail system and to isolate/mitigate system vibrations, is treated as a mechanical transmission element between the rail and the sleepers/slabs.
